messages:
Aisha: FYI vendor moved APAC rack handoff to Monday; they flagged a mandatory firmware preflight. this impacts tomorrow evening's demo slot.
Rory: is the firmware flash something we can do remote via their IPMI, or do they require onsite techs?
Aisha: vendor prefers onsite but will allow remote if we provide a signed access window + jumpbox creds. they want the flash done in a 2hr window.
Ben: how many GPUs will be out of rotation during the flash? we need to know to scale the canary or postpone.
Aisha: about 10x A100 in the apac-demo pool. demo was planning to use 6 concurrently.
Sofia: can we borrow from eu-standby? i can check latency implications quickly.
Rory: EU can lend 4 during the slot, but they have a maintenance job that may add jitter.
Ben: 4 is not enough. two quick options: 1) shrink concurrent workers from 6->4, or 2) move canary to us-central for the test. both have tradeoffs.
Aisha: i'm starting an emergency reservation: ops-bot please file request for +4 GPUs in us-central for 3h starting 2026-03-29T18:00Z.
infra-bot: Reservation request created: RES-9876 | region=us-central | gpus=+4 | window=2026-03-29T18:00Z-21:00Z | priority=urgent. Approvers: @finance @allocs. ETA approval: ~2h.
Sofia: fallback plan if approval stuck: enable prefix caching and reduce batch_size to 4. that should keep latency <150ms.
Rory: if we move to us-central, we'll need a quick DNS TTL change and new certs. QA: set TTL to 30s 15min before cutover.
Ben: can someone paste the terraform snippet to up the pool size? i'll open a PR and link the vault path for node creds.
Aisha: use this minimal patch: ```hcl
variable "demo_gpu_count" { default = 12 }
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "demo" {
  region = "us-central1"
  gpu_count = var.demo_gpu_count
  taints = ["dedicated:demo"]
}
```
Ben: perfect. i'll set var override to 14 in the PR once RES-9876 is approved.
Sofia: i'll run a quick perf probe on eu-standby to confirm RDMA baseline; results in 10m.
Rory: i'll prepare the DNS TTL change and cert generation steps; ping me when the PR is merged.
Aisha: vendor contact says they can accept the remote flash at 09:00 AEST on Mon if we confirm the access window by EOD. Vlad from vendor ops requested a signed access window email.
Ben: can someone draft the access window email? i'll get it signed by security.
Sofia: i'll draft and share a template in the thread in 15m.
infra-bot: Update: RES-9876 status=awaiting_approval. Approvers notified.
Aisha: thanks everyone. if approval doesn't land in 90m we'll shrink concurrent workers and gate the end-to-end test. drop a :no_entry_sign: if you need to escalate.
Ben: noted, standing by to PR if approved.
Sofia: perf probe results: eu->apac p95 added ~12ms during RDMA tune, should be fine for short borrow. posting logs shortly.
Rory: closing note for QA: add "vendor firmware visibility" to infra backlog — recurring flake. can someone file?
Aisha: filing infra ticket now: INFRA-3120. adding link when created.
Sofia: INFRA-3120 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3120
Ben: thanks, thread resolved for now. will update after reservation approval or PR merge.
